mapper.sql: COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approved, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejected, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelled, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS no_show, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expired

FROM reservation r JOIN equipment e ON e.id = r.equipment_id JOIN lab l ON l.id = e.lab_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND e.deleted = 0 AND AND r.apply_time >= #{scope.fromTime} AND r.apply_time < #{scope.toTime}

SELECT CAST(r.apply_time AS DATE) AS stat_date,
GROUP BY CAST(r.apply_time AS DATE) ORDER BY stat_date

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reported, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS accepted, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS repairing, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed FROM repair_order r JOIN equipment e ON e.id = r.equipment_id JOIN lab l ON l.id = e.lab_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND e.deleted = 0 AND AND r.create_time >= #{scope.fromTime} AND r.create_time < #{scope.toTime}
mapper.sql: SELECT e.id AS equipment_id, e.name AS equipment_name, e.lab_id, l.name AS lab_name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(u.start_time, #{scope.fromTime}, COALESCE(e.create_time, #{scope.fromTime})), LEAST(COALESCE(u.end_time, #{scope.effectiveEndTime}), r.end_time, #{scope.effectiveEndTime}) )) END), 0) AS used_seconds, GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(#{scope.fromTime}, COALESCE(e.create_time, #{scope.fromTime})), #{scope.effectiveEndTime})) AS capacity_seconds FROM equipment e JOIN lab l ON l.id = e.lab_id LEFT JOIN reservation r ON r.equipment_id = e.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.end_time > #{scope.fromTime} LEFT JOIN usage_log u ON u.reservation_id = r.id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.start_time < #{scope.effectiveEndTime} AND (u.end_time IS NULL OR u.end_time > #{scope.fromTime}) WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND GROUP BY e.id, e.name, e.lab_id, l.name, e.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(q.used_seconds), 0) AS used_seconds, COALESCE(SUM(q.capacity_seconds), 0) AS capacity_seconds FROM () q
SELECT q.* FROM () q ORDER BY CASE WHEN q.capacity_seconds > 0 THEN LEAST(1.0, q.used_seconds * 1.0 / q.capacity_seconds) ELSE 0 END DESC, q.used_seconds DESC, q.equipment_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT l.id AS lab_id, l.name AS lab_name, COALESCE(us.equipment_count, 0) AS equipment_count, COALESCE(rc.reservation_count, 0) AS reservation_count, COALESCE(us.used_seconds, 0) AS used_seconds, COALESCE(us.capacity_seconds, 0) AS capacity_seconds FROM lab l LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.lab_id, COUNT(*) AS reservation_count GROUP BY e.lab_id ) rc ON rc.lab_id = l.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT q.lab_id, COUNT(*) AS equipment_count, SUM(q.used_seconds) AS used_seconds, SUM(q.capacity_seconds) AS capacity_seconds FROM () q GROUP BY q.lab_id ) us ON us.lab_id = l.id WHERE ORDER BY reservation_count DESC, l.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
